paper_records.title: OCN: Effectively Utilizing Higher-Order Common Neighbors for Better Link Prediction
paper_records.verified_operation: Orthogonalization and walk-participation normalization of higher-order common-neighbor features, aggregated after a shared MPNN and scored by an MLP. Public source uses target edge BCE.
paper_records.relationship: A capable structural representation comparator; not the inspected exact fixed-count two-side subset likelihood.
limits: No proof audit or numeric result adoption
Public cn5/cn7 candidate-batch normalization and README command qualifications preserved
No source execution or current runtime certification

paper_records.title: Feasible Flow Matching for Graph Reconstruction via Within-Sampling Primal-Dual Guidance
paper_records.verified_operation: Reuses a trained PIFM flow; endpoint slack updates nonnegative dual multipliers, whose surrogate-gradient guidance alters later sampling steps. Observation/symmetry support is restored after updates.
paper_records.relationship: Expected-statistic budgets and inference-time graph guidance differ from exactly conditioning TRAIN identity subsets on observed counts in a branch absent at serving.
limits: Theorem proofs, experiments and code not audited
No hard fixed-cardinality conditional law established by the inspected operation
No novelty clearance or code-availability absence claim

paper_records.title: Dynamic Graph Prompting via Topology-Routed Mixed-Curvature Experts
paper_records.verified_operation: Topology/node-time-conditioned soft Top-K routing during pretraining and uniform selected Top-K routing downstream; curvature expert embeddings are combined and trained by BCE plus distortion/balance/orthogonality regularizers.
paper_records.relationship: Direct topology-routed specialization and shared routing context prior, without the inspected ESP subset identity normalizer or two-response posterior responsibility. Bank remains at serving.
limits: Experiments, proofs and code not audited
Recency neighborhood sizes are not hop radii
No benchmark strength adopted from author claims

paper_records.title: Edge-Level Automorphism in GNNs: A Quantitative Framework and Effective Designs For Link Prediction
paper_records.verified_operation: Orbit-size-conditioned stochastic dropout, noisy WL-role embeddings, and a common-neighbor plus endpoint-product link readout.
paper_records.relationship: A stochastic structure-conditioned prior; its Aut(G) orbit-assignment proposition does not certify complete input relabeling or the ordered Single control.
limits: Other theorem proofs and expressiveness claims not audited
No numeric results, author code, or DDI recipe qualified
No identical fixed-count shared-responsibility objective established in read scopes

overall_boundary: The unchanged count-free ranker transfer question beyond independent-side count-conditioned mixtures remains a hypothesis, with classical family/shared-mixture and topology-specialization prior boundaries retained.
